title: A renewed home without rushing happiness

captions.physics: Making domestic changes with both involved
captions.energy: Cutting former routines away too sharply

meaning: Renewing home together brings joy when ending the familiar does not require an immediately positive response to every new condition.
text: You can arrange home through agreement between wishes: choosing together, explaining preferences and preserving each person’s role in change. The Lovers in the physical position of Muladhara describe this openness through action. Death in energy tests your footing through sharply rejecting the former form, as though it should have no further place. The Sun in emotions enjoys a clear result and wants to see you have done well together. Yet joy becomes demanding if new arrangements must immediately replace every familiar comfort, making adjustment seem an obstacle to successful completion.

For example, you choose lighter curtains to replace heavy ones. The room is brighter, but resting in different evening light feels unfamiliar. **A result can be enjoyed while you are still getting used to it.** Wanting to preserve some former comfort does not dismiss the shared choice. A small lighting adjustment helps the new setting become yours, without the work requiring unconditional delight in every consequence as proof of shared success.

The difficulty is hearing any request for correction as refusing to celebrate together. A positive result must then be defended while actual inconvenience remains unspoken. Home looks renewed but feels less free to use. Change offers warmer support when clear joy can coexist with refinement, without recognising the good requiring denial of everything still unfamiliar.
